text:
AVR::disable_cspm_injection
Description
Disables the injection of CSPM javascript to the response payload.
Syntax
AVR
::
disable_cspm_injection
Examples
when
AVR_CSPM_INJECTION
{
if
{[
info
exist
no_cspm
]}
{
AVR
::
disable_cspm_injection
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
AVR_CSPM_INJECTION
- Triggered when
the AVR profile is about to insert a CSPM javascript
